name: Traditional Alcoholic Beverages of Slovenia | Sunheron
snippet: From cviček and teran to brinjevec and medica, explore Slovenia’s historic drinks, how they’re made, and where to taste them in wine bars and farm cellars. Slovenia’s drinking traditions sit at the crossroads of Alpine, Pannonian, and Mediterranean worlds.

name: Slovenia’s National Drink: The Essence of Schnapps and
snippet: The national drink of Slovenia is Schnapps, a broad category of distilled alcoholic beverages, usually fruit brandies. In Slovenia, Schnapps often refers to various fruit-based spirits, with Slivovka being a particularly cherished variety.

name: Slovenian Alcohol: Drinking like a Slovenian - In Your Pocket
snippet: This is of course true on any holiday, but especially true in Slovenia, since Slovenian alcohol is exceptional across all varieties, from craft beers and world-class wines, to awarding-winning gin and homemade moonshine. Here's our quick crash course in all things booze in Slovenia.

name: What are some traditional Slovenian drinks to try alongside
snippet: Some of the most popular traditional Slovenian drinks to try alongside street food are Teran wine, Rakija brandy, and Laško beer. Teran is a red wine made from the Refosco grape variety grown in the Karst region, which has a distinctive earthy flavor that pairs particularly well with meat dishes.

name: Your #1 Top Guide On Slovenian Drinking Culture - ling-app.com
snippet: When visiting Slovenia, you’ll find pubs, bars, and clubs stocked with international drinks, but don’t miss out on the local options! Slovenian alcohol is top-notch, from craft beers and world-class wines to delicious and strong spirits.
